sections.title: Public Sector
sections.subtitle: Modernise public services with secure digital innovation, intelligent automation and Data & AI for citizens and agencies.

sections.heading: Public services designed around people
sections.body:
Citizens need clear, accessible routes to public services. Agencies need connected systems, reliable information and accountable workflows to respond. Modernisation should simplify both sides of that journey while protecting sensitive data.

Linkfields brings application modernisation, integration, automation and Data & AI into public service delivery. We help connect citizen channels with agency operations, strengthen digital foundations and make service information easier to use for planning and oversight.

tools.title: Citizen services
tools.description: Connect enquiries, applications and status updates across digital channels, with clear hand-offs to agency teams.

tools.title: Digital government
tools.description: Modernise legacy applications and design accessible digital workflows that connect public services with agency operations.

tools.title: Secure data
tools.description: Design identity and access controls around citizen information, connected applications and cloud environments.

tools.title: Automation
tools.description: Automate document routing, routine checks and approvals, with staff oversight and clear handling of exceptions.

tools.title: Data & AI
tools.description: Build governed data platforms and analytics to understand service demand, case progress and resource needs.

tools.title: Intelligent Enterprise Platforms
tools.description: Connect finance, procurement and operational workflows with enterprise platforms aligned to agency needs.

sections.title: We are listeners and leaders. Working together to make public services clearer, connected and secure.

items.title: Citizen service portals
items.description: Design accessible self-service journeys for enquiries, applications and progress updates, connected to the teams handling each request.

items.title: Case and document workflows
items.description: Connect records, document routing and approvals so agencies can manage cases with clear ownership and traceable progress.

items.title: Agency system integration
items.description: Use APIs and integration to connect legacy and modern applications, with defined access and data-sharing controls.

items.title: Service planning analytics
items.description: Bring service demand, case volumes and operational data into dashboards that support resource planning and public service oversight.

items.title: Identity and access governance
items.description: Align identity, access reviews and security monitoring with the sensitivity of citizen data and the roles of agency staff.
